dashboards.title: Executive Revenue

tiles.title: Total Revenue
tiles.sql: select sum(amount) as total_revenue from analytics.fct_orders

tiles.title: Gross Revenue Trend
tiles.sql: select order_date, gross_revenue from analytics.mart_daily_sales order by 1

tiles.title: Total Revenue
tiles.sql: select sum(amount - refunds) as total_revenue from analytics.fct_orders

tiles.title: Net Revenue Trend

tiles.title: Weekly Orders
tiles.sql: select date_trunc('week', ordered_at) as week, count(*) as orders from analytics.fct_orders group by 1

tiles.title: Weekly Tickets

tiles.title: Average Order Value
